tldr: Black Moon Lilith in the 12th house.
body: The disowned self is buried in the unconscious; raw instinct you may not see, surfacing in private. The disowned self buried in the unconscious: at once a wound and a gateway. Unexamined it blocks expression; explored, it becomes a source of intuitive depth.
business: Reclaiming hidden power and refusing to disappear brings it to light.
shadow: Self-sabotage from the dark, or repression that leaks out sideways.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
